verdict.rationale: A data-pipeline SaaS could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no built-in assistant. What Jitsu documents instead is an MCP server that lets external AI agents manage the pipeline, which is a different capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
